# Hojicha — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where does Hojicha come from?", "Japan"),

    ("What is base?", "green (roasted)"),

    ("What is note?", "Evening tea"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
